question: What involuntary vocal disturbance affects the practitioner when reciting all mantras and mudras?
premises: The entire group of mantras and mudras is involved
The practitioner utters them in a disturbed way
This is presented as a sign
inference: He utters all the mantras and mudras in a stammering manner.
